Definition: a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings
BiblicalUsage: 1) swinging, waving, wave offering, offering; 1a) a swinging, brandishing; 1a1) of God's hand, weapons; 1b) waving, wave-offering (technical term of sacrifice); 1c) offering (of gold or brass)
